value.rationale: Integrated squared path energy is a natural nonlinear observable of stochastic dynamics. Under the smallest nontrivial sparse sensing budget the exact optimum is globally centered and strictly interior, unlike general linear OU integral design rules. The unique long-horizon gap provides an intrinsic correlation-length scale. The result includes an exact finite-horizon scalar reduction and an explicit limiting value without suggesting unnecessary generic accuracy or computational benefits.
